prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 2D game ground-and-terrain tileset CONCEPT SHEET, visual reference for a future hand-made 16x16-pixel tileset for the cartoon beach game Beatch Slash!. Create only the concept sheet.

Input images 1 and 2 are the two original game covers. Study ONLY their environment: golden sand with scattered pebbles and shells, turquoise ocean with white foam waves, orange-tan rocks with purple-blue shadows, green tropical vegetation. Do not include any character, logo, kiosk, object prop or text from the covers.

Primary request: a polished landscape 1536x1024 concept sheet on a completely uniform pale warm gray background. Show separate square terrain samples, straight from above, top-down orthographic, no perspective. Arrange them into six clearly separated groups in a loose spacious grid with generous margins. Only one small clear Italian label beneath each group: "SABBIA", "SABBIA BAGNATA", "BATTIGIA", "ACQUA", "SCOGLIO", "ERBA". No title, numbers, palette legend, arrows or other lettering. No swatch borders, drop shadows, frames or paper texture.

Swatches:
1. SABBIA: exactly 4 golden sand variants: clean; one tiny pebble; one tiny shell; soft ripple marks expressed as hard-edged flat-color shapes. All four look mutually tileable, the same base color at edges, mostly quiet open sand.
2. SABBIA BAGNATA: exactly 2 darker damp-sand variants.
3. BATTIGIA: 12 square transition samples: 4 straight edges (north/east/south/west), 4 convex outer corners and 4 concave inner corners. In each sample the terrain sequence is golden sand, darker damp sand, a thick clearly visible white foam line, shallow turquoise water. Keep consistent transition-band widths so the samples look joinable.
4. ACQUA: exactly 3 tileable-looking shallow/deep turquoise water variants, only a few simple chunky light sparkles.
5. SCOGLIO: flat orange-tan rock platform top surface with purple-blue shadows. Include a fill sample and square edge/corner samples where rock meets sand. Rock is a flat terrain platform seen vertically from above, no isometric block, no oblique cliff wall, no standing boulder.
6. ERBA: low tropical green grass/vegetation terrain patches and square edge samples blending grass into sand. Ground cover only, no trees or tall props.

Binding style: the covers' sunny warm saturated cartoon look and the approved game's illustrated-icon cel-shading language, simplified for eventual pixel art. Exactly four flat discrete tones per material; light consistently from top-left. Golden sand palette exclusively #8a6a3e #b8925a #e3c084 #f6e2b0. Turquoise water; white foam; orange-tan rock with purple-blue shadow; warm lively greens. Clean dark warm-brown outline #3a1418 ONLY at rock and vegetation edges, never around sand/water samples. Chunky large simple shapes with crisp hard stepped pixel edges; restrained detail that survives redrawing at 16x16 pixels per tile. No gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, soft glow, dithering or photographic/grainy texture. This is an attractive coherent visual development sheet, not a screenshot of a tile editor.

Avoid: characters, logos, kiosks, props, text other than the six exact Italian group labels, realistic textures, dark moody lighting, watermarks, perspective distortion, tiny busy details, 3D dioramas, drop shadows.
